name: Palia – Food Recipes
description: The food recipes of Palia and their ingredients. Tick Acquired for the recipes you know, set To craft on the dishes you want, and the Materials list shows the ingredients to gather.

items.name: Akwinduu Chapaa
items.description: Chapaa patties in mushroom gravy, served with roast potatoes. Invented by a wealthy Akwinduu chef and loved by fancy people worldwide.

items.name: Anch' 'n Grits
items.description: Everybody's so creative! I know what you're thinking, you probably would have used shrimp, but you might not have shrimp available, so what do you use? Anchovy, that's right! And don't forget the cheesy, or it won't slide down easy!

items.name: Apple Pie
items.description: An apple pie made with heartwarming spices. A Daiya family recipe specially created to beat those snobs in Harvest Meadows.

items.name: Bacon-Stuffed Mushrooms
items.description: Sautéed mushroom caps stuffed with bacon and tomato. A dish Delaila used to win Badruu's heart.

items.name: Bean Burger
items.description: A burger for the health-conscious... or just the bean lover!

items.name: Beans On Toast
items.description: The beans go on TOP of the toast. If you do it the other way, you've made Toast on Beans instead.

items.name: Blueberry Pie
items.description: A pie with a sweet and tangy blueberry filling, perfect for a summer picnic.

items.name: Bouillabaisse
items.description: A rich seafood stew, served with potatoes and bread. Perhaps ancient humans once enjoyed this.

items.name: Breakfast Skillet
items.description: Skillets, the stir fry of the breakfast world.

items.name: Candied Kopaa Nuts
items.description: A quick convenient snack for the Palian on the go.

items.name: Celebration Cake
items.description: Delicious, decorated, and designed for special occasions, it's a piece of cake to make this pretty cake. Just do the cooking by the book.

items.name: Chapaa Asada Tacos
items.description: Seasoned chapaa meat fresh off the grill, and thinly-chopped onions tucked snugly into a crispy corn tortilla. What's not to like?

items.name: Chapaa Masala
items.description: Tender cubes of chapaa meat cooked in a rich curry, garnished with fresh cream. For those who need more spice in their life.

items.name: Chapaa Onigiri
items.description: Bring home the taste of Maji Market by making these rice balls stuffed with buttery chapaa meat. They fit conveniently in your pockets!

items.name: Chili Oil Dumplings
items.description: Dumplings, except with chili oil to give each bite a nice fiery kick. Best enjoyed in anything but a white shirt.

items.name: Congee
items.description: Humble rice slow simmered over a fire until it turns into a soft porridge. Simple and hearty.

items.name: Crab Boil
items.description: Crabs is bugs, but that doesn't make this boil any less delicious! Just don't think about it too much.

items.name: Crab Gumbo
items.description: The only thing better than crab is crab stewed with mouth-watering ingredients that give the dish a hint of salt, spice, and everything nice.

items.name: Crab Pot Pie
items.description: This pie has it all: a flaky, buttery crust, hearty stewed veggies, and an irresistibly decadent crab filling. Serve it at the dinner table, and your guests will be singing your praises for years to come.

items.name: Cream of Mushroom Soup
items.description: Mushroom soup packed with aliums and earthy flavors, thickened with cream. Jina's favorite brain food.

items.name: Cream of Tomato Soup
items.description: A tomato soup thickened with cream, served with a baguette. Seems like Reth may be trying something new.

items.name: Creamy Carrot Soup
items.description: A yummy, cream soup guaranteed to use up all your carrots. If you didn't feed them to the ormuu already.

items.name: Dawnspur Tea
items.description: Which came first, the horse or the lily? Either way, it's quite obvious which one this tea tastes like. Hopefully.

items.name: Elderwood Pie
items.description: A savory pie made from ingredients native to the Elderwood. Little Bumble's favorite!

items.name: Fern Tea
items.description: Very earthy, somewhat spicy, always a delight.

items.name: Fish Stew
items.description: A basic fish stock seasoned with garlic and spices. Buffs fishing reticle speed for a short time.

items.name: Fish Tacos
items.description: Loaded with perfectly seasoned fish, these crunchy tacos will have you jumping over the moons.

items.name: Fisherman's Brew
items.description: This suspicious drink has a strange odor that can only be described as 'mossy,' but Einar swears by it. Buffs fishing reticle size for a short time.

items.name: Flowtato Fries with Ketchup
items.description: Crispy on the outside, fluffy on the inside, with homemade tangy ketchup.

items.name: Fried Catfish Dinner
items.description: Battered, fried catfish served with a fresh, tomato salsa. Taylin's favorite weeknight dish for picky children.

items.name: Fruit Smoothie Bowl
items.description: A popular breakfast in Akwinduu for how easy it is to customize!

items.name: Grilled Fish
items.description: Grill fish on a fire, and you've got food.

items.name: Grilled Meat
items.description: When heat grills meat, you've got a great meal

items.name: Grilled Mushroom
items.description: Munch on these mushrooms grilled over a campfire.

items.name: Grilled Oyster
items.description: Oysters grilled over an open fire, no oven needed!

items.name: Hearty Vegetable Soup
items.description: A Classic Kilima soup packed with foraged mushrooms and farm-fresh vegetables, made any way you like.

items.name: Heather Tea
items.description: Drink. It. Up.

items.name: Highlands Bratwurst
items.description: Nothin' better than a juicy brat before the game. Just try not to drop it when you do the wave!

items.name: Hot Hounds
items.description: A freshly-cooked sausage drizzled in sauce and wrapped in a toasty bread bun. Eat it while it's hot!

items.name: Jaakcat Stew
items.description: The secret ingredient is gristle.

items.name: Kimchi Fried Rice
items.description: Take your tastebuds on an adventure of a lifetime with a hot bowl of kimchi fried rice. Its strong and addicting flavors will have you wanting seconds.

items.name: Loaded Flowtato
items.description: This Loaded Flowtato is the perfect side dish. Pick a big enough Flowtato and it can be an entire meal on its own!

items.name: Loaded Potato Soup
items.description: A dense, potato soup packed with filling bacon. Najuma's treat for her father after a long day in the mines.

items.name: Lotus Leaf Tea
items.description: Made from the leaves of young lake lotuses, dried and gently roasted for delicate flavor.

items.name: Lucky Braised Fish
items.description: A whole fish, braised in a savory deep-colored soy sauce and topped with ginger and scallions. Enjoy it during Luna New Year for an abundance of good luck.

items.name: Macaron
items.description: Light, delicate cookie sandwiches filled with buttercream. It's hard to eat just one.

items.name: Meaty Stir Fry
items.description: A healthy mix of sautéed meat and vegetables, served with rice. Still filled with the heat of the wok even after it's served.

items.name: Mushroom Dumpling Soup
items.description: Not only is mushroom dumpling soup good for your health, but soothing for the soul, too. One steaming bowl will leave you feeling rejuvenated.

items.name: Mushroom Quiche
items.description: A savory quiche. The mushrooms compliment the cheese perfectly.

items.name: Muujin Bahari
items.description: A rich, meaty, sumptuous dish that was the favorite of Baron Hepzikiah von Bahari. Legend tells he would eat five a day, every day, and nothing else. Historians remain divided on what role, if any, this diet had in the masive heart attack that claimed his life at the tragically young age of 27.

items.name: Oysters Akwinduu
items.description: Spiced veggies and meat baked on the half shell. Recently voted "Most inefficient way to eat bacon" by Stew & Brine Magazine

items.name: Palian Onion Soup
items.description: Simple soup using base of garlic and carmelized onions, often made by Eshe's childhood housekeeper.

items.name: Pan Fried Dumplings
items.description: Crispy, juicy, and tasty, these mouth-watering dumplings are fried to crispy perfection. Best enjoyed with a dipping sauce.

items.name: Petit Fives
items.description: A bite-sized morsel of cloying joy. Neat as a pin, these delicacies were designed by the oddly geometrical chef John Petit. It's a waste of cake, but the man loved his pentagons.

items.name: Phoenixfire Relleno
items.description: A spicy pepper, coated with egg and stuffed with your choice of meat. A single bite will have you working up a sweat! Or send you straight to the nearest clinic.

items.name: Poke Bowl
items.description: A colorful Maji Market delicacy of raw fish, vegetables, and spices. Popular in Inyrevn due to the region's abundance of fresh seafood.

items.name: Pumpkin Curry and Rice
items.description: This curry boasts a complex flavor profile thanks to its secret ingredient, Kopaa Nuts! Somehow tastes even better the day after you make it.

items.name: Pumpkin Pie
items.description: In Kilima this is a popular seasonal pie during the brisk autumn months, but in Umbraa it's eaten year-round.

items.name: Pumpkin Stew
items.description: A spicy stew made from fresh pumpkin and hearty chunks of meat. Guaranteed to leave you satisfied.

items.name: Quiche Caleri
items.description: A protein-packed breakfast quiche from Caleri's personal recipe book. Enough meat and eggs to keep you going all day... especially when dealing with dog-eared pages and unreturned books.

items.name: Ramen
items.description: Hand-pulled noodles in garlic broth, topped with soft-boiled egg and mushrooms. Can be served in a cup.

items.name: Rice 'n Beans
items.description: Rice AND beans? Together in one dish? Something this novel could only be Ancient.

items.name: Rice Cake Soup
items.description: Unwind after a long day with a hearty bowl of rice cake soup and its delightfully chewy and crunchy textures.

items.name: Rice Cake Stir Fry
items.description: Embrace the wonderful world of stir fry with a fresh serving of stir fried rice cake, and all of the veggie goodness that comes along with it.

items.name: Rockhopper Legs
items.description: Contrary to popular belief, they don't taste much like peki, but they DO make a wonderful dish.

items.name: S'mores
items.description: A delicious campfire treat that Ulfe's mother used to make for him.

items.name: Sashimi
items.description: A minimal meal of slices of raw fish, with a side of plain rice. Buffs fishing rod health for a short time.

items.name: Sernuk Noodle Stew
items.description: An army stew traditionally made with foraged vegetables. Civilian chefs elevated it with spices and noodles.

items.name: Shepp's Pie
items.description: This pie might look simple, but it is anything but. Packed with juicy chapaa meat and a savory mix of seasoned vegetables, this bad boy is an explosion of flavor in each bite.

items.name: Soon Tofu
items.description: Extra soft, silky tofu is the main ingredient of this dish. Each spoonful practically melts in your mouth, and the mild flavor helps cut the spice of the soup base.

items.name: Spicy Crab Fried Rice
items.description: Did a crab fry this rice? Probably not, but a spicy one certainly did make it into this dish, which is as fulfilling as it is fragrant.

items.name: Spicy Honey-Baked Muujin
items.description: The centerpiece of any self-respecting Palian stateswoman's feast.

items.name: Spicy Rice Cakes
items.description: Chewy and flavorful, these rice cakes are stir-fried in a specialty sauce packed with just the right amount of spice. Ancient Humans were said to share this dish at the dinner table together.

items.name: Spicy Stir Fry
items.description: A flaming hot twist to traditional stir fry, this dish will have you thirsty for seconds and a glass of cold water.

items.name: Steak Dinner
items.description: Steak seared in herb butter, served with a baguette. This versatile recipe adapts easily to most meats.

items.name: Steamed Fish
items.description: Steamed whole and flavored with ginger, scallions, and soy sauce, this fish makes for a savory yet light meal. Enjoy it during Luna New Year for an abundance of good luck.

items.name: Stuffed Cabbage Rolls
items.description: Simple yet tasty, these cabbage rolls are stuffed with flavor and make the perfect bite-sized snacks. Drizzle sauce on them for extra enjoyment.

items.name: Stuffed Tomatoes
items.description: Tomatoes in butter, stuffed with their own, spiced, innards. Don't think too hard about it.

items.name: Sushi
items.description: A pleasant meal of seasoned rice topped with raw fish, garnished with spices. Buffs fishing rod health for a short time.

items.name: Trout Dinner
items.description: Garlic-seared trout with potatoes, created so ancient humans could share Einar's love of fishing. Hook fish more quickly for a short time.

items.name: Veggie Chili
items.description: Various nations of the Palian Republic have their own version of this popular dish, but in Umbraa there's only one rule: it HAS to have beans.

items.name: Veggie Fried Rice
items.description: Rice and vegetables fried in a pan with fresh eggs, making a savory main or side dish. Also a great way to use up leftovers.

items.name: Wisteria Tea
items.description: Consumed only by nobility, for its intense preparation requirements make it prohibitively expensive.
